Multi-DLL special section

The Multi-DLL guide covers which APP receives which global extension, matching storage entries, browse controls, compile order, clean/rebuild, and Local Queue, Global Queue, and External File lifetimes. This is a distinct guide because cross-APP setup differs materially from a single-EXE application.
